title: Tokyo Supermarket 8 PM Half-Price Sticker Hunt Hacks
yt_title: [JLPT N5] EP.15 Tokyo Supermarket 8 PM Half-Price Hunt! Hangaku Bento and Sashimi Hacks

cover.jp_line2: 半額シールが貼られます！
cover.grammar_tag: JLPT N5 Grammar: Verb (Plain Form) + と (Natural Condition / Whenever)
cover.translation: 'Whenever 8 PM comes, half-price stickers are placed on prepared food!'

slides.spoken_text: 夜8時になると、お惣菜に半額シールが貼られます。
slides.meaning: When 8 PM arrives, half-price discount stickers are placed on prepared food.
slides.tip: The conditional 'と' indicates an automatic, predictable daily event.

slides.sentence_ja: 夜8時になると、お惣菜に半額シールが貼られます。
slides.grammar_title: Conditional Pattern: Verb (Present) + と (Whenever / As Soon As)
grammar_bullets: Verb plain form + と expresses guaranteed consequences (e.g. at 8 PM, stickers appear).
2割引 (20% off) at 6 PM -> 3割引 (30% off) at 7 PM -> 半額 (50% off) at 8 PM.
High-grade sushi and sashimi platters, karaage fried chicken, and tonkatsu bento.
Do not crowd the clerk with the sticker gun—wait politely until they finish applying the stickers.

shorts.hook_title:
TOKYO 8 PM HALF-PRICE HUNT
IN 30 SECONDS!
shorts.hook_audio_en: Here is how to get 50% off luxury sushi and bento every night in Tokyo supermarkets!
shorts.jp_sentence: 夜8時になると、お惣菜に半額シールが貼られます。
shorts.kana_sentence: よるはちじになると、おそうざいにはんがくしーるがはられます。
shorts.romaji_sentence: Yoru hachi-ji ni naru to, osouzai ni hangaku shiiru ga hararemasu.
shorts.en_translation: At 8 PM, half-price stickers are placed on prepared food.
shorts.pro_tip_body: Look for the red '半額' (hangaku) sticker on fresh sushi and bento boxes after 8 PM!
shorts.pro_tip_audio_en: Look for the red kanji hangaku for instant 50% off deals.
